data.source_title: Effect of a newly designed observation, response and discharge chart in the Post Anaesthesia Care Unit on patient outcomes: a quasi-experimental study in Australia
data.locator: Results; overall PACU LOS distribution and Figure 3A phase comparison
data.source_setting: PACU of an Australian hospital; the study included two implementation phases.
data.source_period: Two study phases; exact calendar dates not stated in the source summary. Overall sample spans both phases.
data.source_n: 1,417 PACU patients overall (63/1,417 had stay >2 hours).
data.quantity: PACU length of stay, overall median
data.source_evidence_basis: Observed PACU admission-to-discharge stay; source reports median 49.0 min (95% CI 47.7–50.3).
data.limitations: One hospital; PACU stay includes clinical recovery and operational discharge processes. Not a fixed service-time requirement.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use as external context for PACU occupancy simulation; model clinical recovery and bed/transport holds as distinct processes where local data permit.
